_readme: SAP Commerce pack knowledge. Structural regexes are stable; the lists under 'seed' semantics carry a version stamp and are refreshed per project (dbcx render research).
standard_units are NOT listed here: adapter.derive_knowledge lists them from hybris/bin/platform and hybris/bin/modules of the client's repository.

check_recipes: at most three sentences each; the scanner records a recipe's trigger per unit (glob [+ content] on unit-relative paths, an adapter signal, or an override resolution) in inventory units.<u>.triggers, and the method renders ONLY triggered recipes into that unit's analyst brief.

message_key_tag_families.note: template liveness is decided by taglib prefix + tag name at the invocation site, never by a tag file's basename - duplicated basenames across sibling tag folders are the accelerator's normal shape

module_name_traps.note: sapinvoiceaddon/bol/facades/services = legacy 'SAP Invoice' (JCo-direct, deprecated Q4 2024, no OCC member of any kind); sapbillinginvoiceocc = the separate, current 'SAP Billing Invoice Integration'; the composable Invoice Display (@spartacus/pdf-invoices) is documented as part of the S/4HANA Order Management Integration - name similarity is not a migration path

Synchronous Order Management module (sapordermgmtservices/bol/b2bfacades/...): deprecated 2211, removed from the installer at 2211-jdk21.1; documented mitigation is module-level (saps4omservices/facades/backoffice/occ), there is no class-level successor for its DTOs; the module also owned SAPConfiguration.sapordermgmt_* attributes

the EXTENSION was deprecated and deleted (registration -> b2bcommerce/b2bcommercefacades, storefront layer -> b2bacceleratoraddon) while CMSSecurePortalRestriction the TYPE still ships at 2211 (first defined at b2bacceleratorservices) - 'extension deleted, capability survives'

check_recipes.title: AddOn installed?
check_recipes.text: Check the two addoninstall footprints before judging deployment: the storefront's extensioninfo.xml requires-extension of the AddOn, and storefront-prefixed lines (additionalWebSpringConfigs, wro4jconfigscan) in the AddOn's project.properties vs project.properties.template. buildcallbacks copying acceleratoraddon/ and gitignored copy targets prove the build-time install; an empty manifest storefrontAddons list proves nothing. project.properties lines absent from the template are hand edits a re-install drops.

check_recipes.title: CMS/AddOn content visible?
check_recipes.text: Three separate tests: (1) the target content catalog exists in this estate and its store/site extension is active (an addon folder for a catalog the site does not have is never read); (2) the ImpEx writes the Online version or a sync runs; (3) for AddOn content, the AddOn is installed. Resolve $macros before quoting any value.

check_recipes.title: Which texts win?
check_recipes.text: Storefront messages resolve database labels first, then AddOn bundles in ALPHABETICAL AddOn order (RequiredAddOnsNameProvider) with fallbackToSystemLocale=false: an earlier English-only base.properties hides later SAP translations. Count key-set intersections per language before stating which languages exist; a singleton theme message source shares the fallback of the theme built last.

check_recipes.title: Process definition: what actually runs
check_recipes.text: Only nodes reachable from the root's start attribute ever run (the evidence shows unreachable nodes; `dbcx process_reach <file>`). For every wait node name the TARGET of each timeout branch: a timeout that rejoins a SUCCEEDED end turns a missing acknowledgement into a business success.

check_recipes.title: Custom cache
check_recipes.text: Compare the key's equals/hashCode fields with what the claim says the key separates by (tenant, site, language, key) and with AbstractCacheKey (tenantId). List invalidation per operation - CREATE as well as UPDATE/DELETE - against every key the fallback path writes, and state the TTL.

check_recipes.title: Which copy executes?
check_recipes.text: A bean with primary="true" wins by-type injection before any name match (DefaultListableBeanFactory); an alias re-points every lookup of the standard id; a parent= bean or subclass in a sibling extension may override the methods you describe. For every service method in a claim, search estate-wide for aliases, primary beans, parent= and extends, and say which copy runs.

check_recipes.title: Standard OCC/API on project beans
check_recipes.text: This unit re-points standard bean ids (evidence). Standard OCC/API resources then call standard methods on the project bean: list which methods it overrides (incl. state filters in DAO queries) before stating what a standard resource returns or that an API gap exists.

check_recipes.title: Secret-like key or column
check_recipes.text: Read the value masked (length and form only, never print it): a placeholder (<...>, empty, ${...}) is not a secret; resolve ImpEx $macros first. For a real literal state whether the file is reachable in production (which import path, which persona/aspect loads it - `dbcx effective_property`) and whether rotation is needed; never relay an unscored secret finding as fact.

check_recipes.title: Bundled jars
check_recipes.text: <extension>/lib lands on the GLOBAL classpath: compare each jar's embedded META-INF/maven/**/pom.xml dependencies with the jars in this lib/, the platform and sibling extensions; report missing and version-clashing jars and any dependency only a sibling extension ships (load order, no requires-extension).

check_recipes.title: Integration API hooks
check_recipes.text: Integration API persistence hooks are chosen per request by the Pre-Persist-Hook / Post-Persist-Hook HTTP header the caller (e.g. CPI) sends - no repository file names which hook runs; say so instead of hunting. The named bean must implement PrePersistHook/PostPersistHook (SpringBeanPersistenceHookProvider); an AfterSaveListener is a different mechanism.

check_recipes.title: Build-time patch of a vendor file
check_recipes.text: Name the patched vendor file and the matched pattern: a regex that no longer matches after an upgrade silently does nothing (no build failure). Check the pattern against the TARGET version's file.

check_recipes.title: Tenant-scoped bean state
check_recipes.text: scope="tenant" is ONE shared instance per tenant (the tenant scope resolves to the singleton), not one per job run: a tenant-scoped job or performable keeping run state in instance fields shares it across concurrent runs.

check_recipes.title: Generated from a vendor template

trigger.signal: adapter: template_diff found a vendor template

check_recipes.text: Only modified and new files are client logic (`dbcx template_diff <repo> <unit>`); never call an unchanged template copy a patch of standard. Judge a modified or overriding class against the shipped class of the TARGET version - the workaround may be obsolete or now harmful.

check_recipes.title: Effective property values
check_recipes.text: Before stating an effective value, or that a vendor default applies, resolve the key with `dbcx effective_property <repo> <key>` (manifest.json useConfig chain per persona/aspect; deployment-time Cloud Portal layers stay invisible - say so).

check_recipes.title: items.xml locator
check_recipes.text: A grep hit on a qualifier in an items.xml proves the string exists, not which type owns it: derive the owning <itemtype> block (its start and end lines) before citing a range, the way an ImpEx value needs its header. Cite the block of the type the statement is about.

check_recipes.title: AddOn core-data import folder
check_recipes.text: The addonsupport Core Data Import hook reads the fixed `template` folder and injects the catalog identity by ImpEx macro substitution; per-catalog-named folders belong to the separate AddOn Sample Data Import. Say which of the two mechanisms reads the files you cite.

check_recipes.title: PunchOut on the target
check_recipes.text: Standard b2bpunchoutocc covers the PunchOut transport (profile, setup, order, session, requisition); estate-specific session policy (compliance checks, preview or group state, custom authentication) still needs its own OCC extension or backend hook. Split the two instead of calling the unit wholly standard or wholly custom.

check_recipes.title: Checkout steps and their wiring
check_recipes.text: In the accelerator a checkout step controller and its bean/transition wiring can live in different units: merge="true" maps in multi-step-checkout-config.xml let an AddOn contribute steps to the storefront's map. Cite the file that actually contributes the entry, and search sibling AddOns before calling a step unwired.

check_recipes.title: Target API and feature library
check_recipes.text: A D4 statement that standard OCC covers something names the OCC extension (e.g. commercewebservices, b2bocc) and the composable-storefront feature library that consumes it; where no feature library exists (e.g. checkout), that absence is the finding. Take library names from the vendor documentation, not from memory.

check_recipes.title: Deployed type names
check_recipes.text: A type-system-generated export (alltypes.impex-style header written from a running type system) is repository evidence of deployed type, attribute and descriptor names, trimmed as the database holds them. Use it when items.xml is ambiguous (e.g. trailing spaces, localized columns), and say it reflects the system it was exported from.

check_recipes.title: Control flow after a platform failure
check_recipes.text: Platform services often rethrow unchecked (e.g. DefaultMediaService.setStreamForMedia on an unsaved model throws ModelSavingException), so a step after a swallowed save may never be reached. Reproduce every 'reached even after a failure' statement against the platform bytecode (javap), not from the custom code alone.

check_recipes.title: Backoffice visibility
check_recipes.text: A type without its own editor-area falls back to the standard Item editor area, whose unbound section shows every attribute not placed elsewhere; a type-level right covers all attributes unless an attribute-level right exists. Check that fallback before claiming an attribute is not visible or only readable as a list column.

check_recipes.title: Where media are stored
check_recipes.text: manifest.json image-processing flags (enableImageProcessingService, cloudmediaconversion) switch image processing, not media storage: the storage strategy per media folder (media.folder.*.storage.strategy, none set = platform default) decides where media live, and CCv2 is blob-backed by default. Check the strategy layer before inferring a media location.
